retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast duotone portrait featuring a central subject framed by a foreground circular element and minimalist sans-serif typography at the top edge.
excludeWhen: serif or decorative fonts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly angled portrait of a person with dark hair and sunglasses, captured through a large, out-of-focus circular loop that creates a dynamic frame. The image uses a desaturated, warm-tinted duotone palette with a thin black border and clean, lowercase sans-serif text positioned in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular foreground element creates a frame-within-a-frame that directs focus to the subject's face.
The subject's dark sunglasses and hair contrast sharply against the lighter, hazy background.
The thin black border contains the composition, providing a structural anchor for the typography.
The typography is pushed to the extreme top edge, creating a sense of modern, airy balance.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally but slightly offset vertically, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, thick circular loop in the foreground acts as the primary visual anchor and framing device.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the foreground loop to the subject's face, then moves upward to the text in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space is provided by the blurred, light-colored background behind the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm grey/sepia-tinted midtones for skin and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for hair, sunglasses, clothing, and the foreground loop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white for the outer border and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark subject and light background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title to maintain minimalist cohesion.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and wide tracking potential.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a duotone portrait of a person with dark hair and sunglasses, shot through a large out-of-focus black cable or loop. Use a grainy film texture and a thin black border around the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners, inside the border. Use wide tracking and a medium weight.

verificationChecks: Is there a foreground circular element framing the face?
Is the color palette restricted to a warm duotone?
Is the text pushed to the top corners?

adjustableVariables: Tint of the duotone (sepia, cool grey, or cyanotype)
Thickness of the foreground framing loop
mustRedesign: Do not remove the black border
postGenerationChecks: Check for thin black border consistency
Ensure foreground loop is sufficiently blurred
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast duotone portrait with a foreground geometric frame and corner-justified lowercase sans-serif type for a classic new wave aesthetic.
